title: gastrolobium dilatatum
intro: Gastrolobium dilatatum, commonly known as the Ouchita Vine or Poison Vine, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating wounds, reducing fever, and relieving pain. The therapeutic actions of Gastrolobium dilatatum include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce nausea, and alleviate digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
